definitions.explanation: The act of guiding or leading someone, especially helping them learn or navigate something new.
A written document that provides instructions or guidance on how to do something.

examples.japanese: ⟦{先輩|せんぱい}→先輩：01451_senpai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{手引|てび}き⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{覚|おぼ}えた→覚える：00739_oboeru⟧。
examples.english: I learned the job under the guidance of my senior.

examples.japanese: ⟦{内部|ないぶ}→内部：05583_naibu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人間|にんげん}→人間：03523_ningen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{犯人|はんにん}→犯人：03572_hannin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{手引|てび}き⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧らしい。
examples.english: It seems an insider aided and abetted the criminal.
examples.notes: Can also mean to secretly assist someone in wrongdoing.

examples.japanese: ⟦{地元|じもと}→地元：09941_jimoto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{手引|てび}き⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦なければ→ない：01118_nai⟧、⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{場所|ばしょ}→場所：00829_basho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧たどり{着|つ}けなかった。
examples.english: Without the guidance of a local person, I could not have reached this place.

examples.japanese: ⟦{利用|りよう}→利用：01752_riyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{手引|てび}き⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}む→読む：00426_yomu⟧。
⟦{入学|にゅうがく}→入学：02092_nyuugaku⟧{手引|てび}き⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{届|とど}いた→届く：00899_todoku⟧。
⟦{初心者|しょしんしゃ}→初心者：10149_shoshinsha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{手引|てび}き⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作成|さくせい}した→作成する：25378_sakuseisuru⟧。
examples.english: I created a guide for beginners.

notes:
{手引|てび}き has two main uses: personal guidance (someone leading or helping you) and written guides or manuals.

NOTE: When used for guidance by a person, {手引|てび}き can have a negative connotation — secretly helping someone gain access or commit wrongdoing (similar to English 'inside help').

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {手引|てび}き⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to guide, to provide assistance
- {手引|てび}き{書|しょ}: guidebook, manual
- ⟦{入門|にゅうもん}→入門：11643_nyuumon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{手引|てび}き: introductory guide
- ⟦{利用|りよう}→利用：01752_riyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{手引|てび}き: usage guide

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ガイド→ガイド：05116_gaido⟧: guide (loanword, casual)
- ⟦マニュアル→マニュアル：26993_manyuaru⟧: manual (loanword)
